_comment: Every board/org token below was probed live on 2026-08-12 and returned jobs. ATS tokens are NOT derivable from company names — of 117 plausible Greenhouse guesses, 52 returned 404. See docs/decisions/0004-job-source-selection.md.
_us_only_comment: Filters to roles a US-based applicant can take. Applied centrally in the ingest handler (src/job_radar/location.py), not per-source, because it is one policy. Tuned to let a few worldwide-remote roles through rather than drop genuine US roles.
_keywords_comment: Multi-word phrases on purpose. A bare 'infrastructure' or 'cloud' matches sales and data-centre-operations roles; measured on the cloudflare board, a loose pattern hit 43/305 including 'GTM Specialist' and 'Customer Engineer'. Precision over recall: a dashboard full of false positives is one you stop reading.
